title: Never-ending cursor
records: JSON data[] → id, title, category, price, rating, createdAt, url

end.description: Never ends: every page has records and a way to the next one. Stop at your own page cap (100 pages at most).

expectedBehaviour: The data never runs out. Collect at least 5 pages, then stop at a page cap of 100 or fewer.
comparison: Requests are compared on method, path and query (in order, decoded), ignoring run/variant/bare/delay and ignoreParams; JSON bodies are compared structurally (GraphQL: variables only). Records are compared order-insensitively by id.
